notes.title: Dr. Suun Release Date and Time
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We’re thrilled to announce the official release date for Dr. Suun! Mark your calendars for April 11, 2025 at 5:00 P.M. CST!

The first chapter will be completely free, with future chapters available as paid content. While this initial release may be a smaller experience, we hope it draws you into the mystery and excitement of what's to come.

As we move forward, we’re committed to delivering even bigger and better games. To make that happen, we’re expanding our development team from one to three members—a big step toward pushing our projects to the next level.

Thank you all for your incredible support. We can’t wait for you to experience Dr. Suun!

– BigTank Games
